confidence.rationale: Observed once in Macro-Mission 01; no operational write was performed.

decision_rules: A legacy write is not acceptable as a safe surface until owner, storage, containment, rollback, and failure behavior are proven.

evidence_refs.claim: Domain materialization was safe only inside its documented boundary.
Sandbox containment and rollback are separate proof obligations.

failure_modes: Treating an existing writer as an authorized product persistence path.
preconditions: A source write or materializer is visible in the repository.
procedure: Classify its storage root and sensitivity.
Verify path containment and rollback contracts.
Keep product execution disabled until all boundaries are proven.
recovery: Use an isolated fixture or documentation-only evidence and leave the operational path untouched.
stop_conditions: No product store, external data, or operational traffic may be touched.
summary: A legacy write needs explicit ownership, containment, rollback, and failure-boundary proof.
title: Legacy write needs boundary proof
validation: Macro 01 route reconnaissance and sandbox rollback contract tests.
